server.tooltip.external: Address provided to clients for connecting to the server.
server.tooltip.listen: Local address and port on which the server accepts incoming connections.
server.tooltip.backend: Local address and port of the backend server to which the server forwards traffic.
server.tooltip.client_auth: Determines whether clients need to authenticate against the client list.
server.info.external: External server address used by clients to connect. This can be a public IP address or a DNS name accessible to clients from their network. Specify the address and port the client should connect to.
server.info.listen: Local address and port on which the server accepts incoming connections. It is recommended to use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections on all network interfaces. The container veth interface IP can also be used. Changing this parameter requires a server restart.
server.info.backend: Address and port of the local backend server to which FreeTurn Server forwards established connections. For example, this could be WireGuard (default port 51820) or another local service (XRay - 443). Changing this parameter requires a server restart.
server.info.client_auth: Determines whether client authentication is used. If authentication is enabled, the server checks clients against the allowed client list from the clients.json file. If authentication is disabled, connections do not require a client in this list.
server.tooltip.mode: Tunnel mode: UDP relay for WireGuard or TCP forwarder for Xray/sing-box.
server.tooltip.obf_profile: Payload obfuscation profile. Must match the profile configured on the client.
server.tooltip.obf_key: Shared key used by the client and server for the selected obfuscation profile.
server.tooltip.obf_timing: Inter-packet delay used for RTP mimicry.
uri.tooltip.n: Total number of parallel TURN streams the client will use.
uri.tooltip.spc: Maximum number of parallel TURN streams using one VK accounts cache. Cannot exceed the total number of TURN streams (spc ≤ n).
uri.tooltip.dns: DNS resolution method used by the client.
uri.tooltip.dnss: List of DNS servers in the ip[:port][,ip[:port]...] format.
uri.tooltip.mcap: When enabled, VK captcha solving is performed manually by the user.
uri.tooltip.bond: Distribute a single TCP connection across all active client sessions. The parameter applies only to TCP mode.
uri.tooltip.transport: Transport to the TURN relay. UDP lowers latency, TCP is more stable.
server.backend_status_hint: Checks host and port. 'Available' — host and port respond; 'Port unavailable' — host pings, port is closed; 'IP unreachable' — host does not respond. For UDP, a closed port is detected via ICMP port-unreachable; service silence (WireGuard/Xray) is treated as normal.
